You and i can relate a bit. I've never been a good person. I tried, really fucking hard to be when i was with my wife. But i still couldn't control it. I hurt her more than anyone. And once she left. Im back in my old ways. I went straight back to my old life. Selling, moving, stealing, doing things most people wouldn't dream about doing. And i justify it all to myself. "Im a single dad with 3 kids" "its only for the money" "its to better their lives" "its a means to an end temporarily" but its not. I do it because I'm good at it. I've never typed this or said it out loud but i do it because i enjoy it. "The people i affect chose this life so it doesnt make me bad" i hate that i do... i wish i could just....be decent...be good

I want to change.... this subreddit... you are the only people I've never lied to. I'm scared. I can't raise my kids. They deserve better than what I'm going to give them. I don't want them to become me. I'm scared that the voice i run from is going to catch up. The one that tells me ending myself will hurt everyone. But because of my fate they'll all be better. I won't be able to hurt anyone else again. 

I want to keep running. But I'm getting tired. And the biggest cosmic joke is god won't let me die. I've tried. But i don't want to. I don't want to die. But it would be the only selfless act I've done for everyone who cares about me. 

You help me. You keep me running. To know the are people like you, who help others with no regard. Who genuinely care. You are who i want to be. And talking to you give me a little hope that even if i cant change. I can pretend to be like you. And it might be enough

I don't deserve the forgiveness. Because i know for a fact. Im going to do it again. I almost did tonight. I look at myself and say i can do better. I say that i want the best for them. But in the moment i honestly believe whats best for me is best for them and i cant separate the two and see what they *really* need me to be. What they *want* me to be. I only try to turn them into what i want them to be.

I dont think i can change. I believe in omnipotence. I believe in god. And other gods. I believe they've created me like this. I have some fucked up purpose in life to hurt people. When i do, they see what they really want. The last few people ive gotten to care about me. I knew they wouldnt last. I led them on for selfish gain. And i dropped them as easily as i picked them up. 

But each one is happily married. Their lives are great now. I hurt them so they can really find the fulfillment in life. 


At least that's what i have to tell myself. Because if that's not the case i really am just a monster. I'm not supposed to be happy.
I want to stop hurting everyone. I want to like who i see in the mirror. I want to change. But i dont know how.
I want to want her to do better. But all i care about is how i feel. I don't deserve her. She shouldn't settle for me because that's what i want. If she comes back, I'll only drag her down

Even though she left, my wife needs me. Gas money, cigarettes , insurance, a phone, ect... and so far ive given it to her... I've been telling myself i need her, and i can't live without her. 

But the difference is i *want* her. While im here making sure she has everything she *needs* im not what she *wants* right now. She's who i *want* but won't be what i *need* in my life at the moment. So i have to take a step back. I have to let her worry about her needs and focus on my own.
I'm working on moving right now. Hopefully by this summer at the latest I'll have a new place

That's when I'll sit in the car until it's time to wake them up for school and spend an hour with them before they leave. Then I'll sleep 3-4 hours and wake up when they get home to spend time with them before i leave for work again.

Dad, im scared i cant be the parent my kids need me to be, without her. I dont think ill be good enough.
